# Overview
This document shows Mermaid diagrams in a Quarto document rendered with the
Typst PDF engine. The examples use `%%|` for Quarto chunk options inside
Mermaid blocks.
# Admission Workflow
```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-admission-flow
%%| fig-cap: "University admission workflow"
%%| fig-width: 8
%%| fig-height: 10
%%| out-width: "80%"
%%| fig-align: center
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "flowchart": {"nodeSpacing": 30, "rankSpacing": 45}, "themeVariables": {"fontSize": "12px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
    A[Student applies] --> B[University verifies documents]
    B --> C{Complete?}
    C -->|No| D[Request missing documents]
    D --> B
    C -->|Yes| E[Review application]
    E --> F{Decision}
    F -->|Accepted| G[Send offer letter]
    F -->|Waitlisted| H[Notify waitlist status]
    F -->|Rejected| I[Send rejection notice]
```
See @fig-admission-flow for the main admission workflow.
# Admission Sequence
```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-admission-sequence
%%| fig-cap: "Student and university admission process"
%%| fig-width: 12
%%| fig-height: 5.5
%%| fig-align: center
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "sequence": {"showSequenceNumbers": true, "mirrorActors": false}, "themeVariables": {"fontSize": "12px"}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
    actor Student
    participant Portal as Application Portal
    participant Admissions as Admissions Office
    participant Committee as Review Committee
    Student->>Portal: Create account
    Portal-->>Student: Confirm registration
    Student->>Portal: Submit application and documents
    Portal->>Admissions: Forward completed application
    Admissions->>Admissions: Verify documents
    alt Documents incomplete
        Admissions-->>Student: Request missing documents
        Student->>Portal: Upload missing documents
        Portal->>Admissions: Send updated application
    else Documents complete
        Admissions->>Committee: Send application for review
        Committee-->>Admissions: Return decision
        Admissions-->>Student: Notify admission decision
    end
```
# Admissions Timeline
The Gantt chart is placed on a landscape page because timeline diagrams are
wide and can become compressed on portrait PDF pages.
```{=typst}
#pagebreak()
#page(flipped: true)[
```
```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-admissions-gantt
%%| fig-cap: "Admissions timeline"
%%| fig-width: 11
%%| fig-height: 5.5
%%| fig-align: center
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "gantt": {"barHeight": 22, "fontSize": 11}}}%%
gantt
    title Admissions Timeline
    dateFormat  YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat  %d %b
    section Application
    Submit form       :a1, 2026-07-01, 7d
    Document review   :a2, after a1, 10d
    section Decision
    Committee review  :b1, after a2, 14d
    Decision made     :b2, after b1, 3d
    section Enrollment
    Accept offer      :c1, after b2, 7d
    Pay deposit       :c2, after c1, 5d
```
```{=typst}
]
#pagebreak()
```
# Notes
For Typst PDF output, Mermaid diagrams are static graphics. If a diagram looks
compressed, prefer top-to-bottom layouts, reduce Mermaid font size, increase
`fig-width` and `fig-height`, or move wide diagrams to a landscape page.
